title: NBA Sim GameResult Output (foundation 0.1.0)
description: Top-level shape of the object returned by simulateGame(input) -> GameResult (T19). The shape is frozen: meta carries the run provenance; events is the delta-encoded timeline (T2); box_score holds the per-player traditional counting stats for both teams; possession_log summarizes each possession. The PlayerBox field set is the canonical traditional NBA box score (Metis G3.6): 18 counting + identity fields, exactly. Advanced derived stats (TS%, USG%, PER, BPM, etc.) are intentionally excluded from the foundation and must be computed post-hoc by consumers.

events.description: Ordered list of timeline events emitted by the engine. Each event MUST be an instance of one of the EventType entries in config/event-catalog.json (T2). Empty array is permitted only for early-abort run shapes; a completed game has events.length > 50 (acceptance criterion T19).

snapshots.description: Continuous WorldSnapshot series at tick resolution (position truth for 0.3.0+).

home.description: Per-player box stats for the home team. One entry per player who appeared in the game (starter or subbed in).

away.description: Per-player box stats for the away team.

possession_log.description: One entry per terminated possession, in chronological order. Used by the pace regression (T21) to compute per-team mean possession length, pace (possessions per 48 min), and transition share.

stamina_report.description: §8 stamina report per jersey: ceiling, end-of-game STM, consumption, recovery earned, fatigue F = max(0, consumed − rest).

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp copied from config/foundation.json#foundation_version at simulation time. Two GameResult objects with different foundation_version are not directly comparable.

seed.description: uint32 seed passed to mulberry32 (T12). Identical seed + identical input + identical foundation_version implies byte-identical events and final score (golden fixture T20).

home_team_id.description: Identifier of the home team (matches config/demo-game.json team id).

started_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp marking when simulateGame was invoked. Used for human-readable provenance only; never consumed by the kernel or by replay (the timeline is fully logical-clock driven).

type.description: EventType name; must be a member of config/event-catalog.json#events[].type (cross-referenced by the foundation linter, T9).

t_game.description: Game-clock timestamp in seconds at which the event was emitted. Quantized to 0.1s per docs/foundation/clocks-duration.md (T6).

period.description: Period number. 1..4 for regulation; >=5 for overtimes (decision M6).

timelineEvent.$comment: Per-event payload fields are intentionally permissive (additionalProperties: true). The required-payload-fields contract for each EventType lives in config/event-catalog.json and is enforced by the foundation linter (T9). The schema here only pins the structural trio (type, t_game, period) common to every event.

playerId.description: Stable player identifier; matches the `id` field from config/identity.json (T7).

jersey.description: Jersey number/string worn by the player for this game.

teamId.description: Team identifier the player appeared for in this game.

points.description: Total points scored (2*fgm + 3*tpm + ftm). Schema does not enforce the invariant; the engine guarantees it and the linter (T9) may add a runtime check.

minutes.description: Total time played in seconds (or fractional minutes; engine convention documented in T19). Type is number to permit fractional minutes; non-negative.

playerBox.$comment: The PlayerBox is the canonical traditional NBA box score for v0.1.0 (Metis G3.6): identity (playerId, jersey, teamId) + traditional counting stats (points, fgm, fga, tpm, tpa, ftm, fta, oreb, dreb, ast, tov, pf, stl, blk) + minutes. Exactly 18 keys are permitted, no more, no less: required lists all 18, additionalProperties: false rejects any extras, and minProperties=maxProperties=18 rejects both missing keys and any future addition. Advanced derived statistics (TS%, eFG%, USG%, PER, BPM, DBPM, OBPM, VORP, win shares, etc.) are OUT of the foundation; downstream consumers compute them from this canonical set. Adding or removing a PlayerBox field is a major foundation_version bump.

possession_id.description: 0-indexed sequence number of this possession within the game.

period.description: Period in which the possession began.

offensive_team_id.description: Team that had the ball at the start of the possession.

mode.description: Mode selected by mode_select (T17) at possession start.

start_reason.description: Why the possession started (JUMP_BALL_TAP, AFTER_MAKE, AFTER_DREB, AFTER_STEAL, AFTER_LIVE_BALL_TURNOVER_RECOVER, AFTER_OREB_CONTINUE, etc.). OREB continuation is represented as a new possession_id for the audit log only; the engine does NOT rebind roles (Metis G1.8).

end_reason.description: Terminal state of the possession (MAKE, MISS_DREB, MISS_OREB_CONTINUE, TURNOVER, SHOOTING_FOUL, NON_SHOOTING_FOUL_DEAD, VIOLATION, SHOT_CLOCK_VIOLATION, PERIOD_END, etc.).

possessionEntry.$comment: OREB continuation: per Metis G1.8, when an offensive rebound occurs the same RoleBinding persists (no rebind) and the shot clock resets to 14 (see clocks-duration.md T6). For audit purposes the possession_log may surface either a single possession spanning the OREB or two entries linked by start_reason=AFTER_OREB_CONTINUE; the engine convention is documented in docs/foundation/possession-plays.md (T8). The schema permits both representations.
